cards.title: Propositional logic: syntax and semantics
cards.hook: Facts + rules in a knowledge base let an agent derive what to do (rain → wet → indoor route).
formula: false only when P = T and Q = F
example: 'If 2 + 2 = 5, then x > 3' is TRUE (vacuously: the premise is false).
cards.memory: Implication is a promise: only broken when the condition happens and the result doesn't.
cards.trap: P ⇒ Q asserts no causation, and is NOT equivalent to Q ⇒ P.

cards.title: Logical equivalences
cards.hook: Rewrite rules that never change truth: your CNF toolkit.
cards.visual:
NameEquivalence
Implication eliminationα ⇒ β ≡ ¬α ∨ β
Biconditional eliminationα ⇔ β ≡ (α⇒β) ∧ (β⇒α)
Contrapositionα ⇒ β ≡ ¬β ⇒ ¬α

cards.memory: De Morgan: flip the operator, negate each part.
cards.trap: The converse (Q ⇒ P) and inverse (¬P ⇒ ¬Q) are NOT equivalent to P ⇒ Q; only the contrapositive is.

cards.title: First-order logic
cards.hook: FOL talks about objects and ALL/SOME of them in one sentence.
cards.visual:

formula: ∀: any ground term; ∃: one NEW constant
example: EI: ∃x Student(x) ∧ Enrolled(x) → Student(k) ∧ Enrolled(k) with fresh k.
cards.memory: A term names a thing; a sentence is true or false.
cards.trap: Quantifier order matters; EI must use a NEW constant.

cards.title: Inference: model checking, theorem proving, resolution
cards.hook: Three ways to show KB ⊨ γ: check every model, chain sound rules, or refute the negation.
formula: list symbols → all models → keep KB-true → check γ
Modus Ponens: P, P ⇒ Q ⊢ Q
example: Rain: only model 1 satisfies KB, and Q is true there → KB ⊨ Q.
Resolution: C1: P, C2: ¬P ∨ Q, C3: ¬Q → resolve C1, C2 → Q; with C3 → □.
cards.memory: Assume the opposite, find the empty box.
cards.trap: Negate ONLY the query (KB ∧ ¬γ), not the KB.
